carpet.rule.stopLightRecalculationDataFi: Prevents the ChunkDeleteLightFix DataFix from erasing the light data out of <=1.19.4 chunks
carpet.rule.commandImportStatsToScoreboa: Imports player statistics into scoreboard objectives
carpet.rule.obtainableInvisibleItemFrame: Makes invisible item frames obtainable by renaming them to "invisible" in an anvil
carpet.rule.disableOpsBypassWhitelist.de: Prevents opped players from bypassing the whitelist
carpet.rule.commandPistonBolt.extra.0: Makes it possible to store and query bolt location encodings
carpet.rule.fixEarlyTicketExpiration.ext: Stops chunk tickets from ticking when their chunk isn't completely loaded.
carpet.rule.portablePearlCannon.extra.0: Multiplies the horizontal velocity of ender pearls by 1000 when thrown
carpet.rule.dontSaveChunks.extra.0: When enabled, stops chunks from being saved to disk, then resumes saving when disabled.
carpet.rule.fixInteractiveCollisions.ext: When enabled, stops entities' interactive collisions from causing lag via excessively loading chunks.
commands.importstatstoscoreboard.importi: There is an ongoing importing procedure.
